White Smoke!

{1}White smoke rises from the chimney of the Sistine Chapel as bells ring across Vatican City. Crowds gathered in St. Peter's Square erupt in celebration. The world now knows that a new Pope has been elected.
Habemus Papam!
You have been elected as the next Pope of the Catholic Church!

You are now the spiritual leader of over 1.3 billion Catholics worldwide. The announcement has been made from the central balcony of St. Peter's Basilica, and you step forward before thousands of cheering people as Pope {1}.
Deliver your first blessing
I gave my first blessing as Pope {1} from the balcony of St. Peter's.
Address the crowd
I addressed the crowd in St. Peter's Square as Pope {1}.
Offer a prayer for peace
I offered a prayer for peace as Pope {1}.
Cardinal {1} {2} was elected Pope after {3} ballots and took the name {4}.
Another cardinal has been elected as the new Pope.
You will continue to serve as a Cardinal and may have another chance in the next conclave.
After {1} rounds of voting, Cardinal {2} {3} of {4} has received the necessary majority and accepted his election as the new Pope. He has taken the name {5}.
Congratulate the new Pope
I congratulated Pope {1}.
Pray for his pontificate
I prayed for Pope {1}'s pontificate.
Return to your duties
Your First Address
You are preparing to deliver your first major address as Pope {1}. Millions of Catholics and observers around the world are waiting to hear your message.
Emphasize peace
You called on the nations to lay down their arms. World leaders praised your words.
Emphasize charity
You asked the Church to be "poor and for the poor". The crowd erupted in applause.
Emphasize Church tradition
You spoke of continuity with the Church's long tradition. Traditional Catholics were delighted.
Emphasize unity
You asked Catholics of every outlook to walk together. Even your critics found it hard to object.
Urbi et Orbi
You blessed the city and the world from the loggia of St. Peter's.
I delivered a papal blessing.
St. Peter's Square
Your Angelus address on {1} was quoted around the world.
A line in your address was taken out of context and sparked an uproar.
I addressed St. Peter's Square.
You already held a consistory this year.
You created {1} new cardinals from {2} countries.
I created {1} new cardinals.
You appointed {1} new bishops to dioceses around the world.
I appointed new bishops.
refugees
Your meeting with the leader of {1} produced a joint statement on {2}.
Your meeting with the leader of {1} was awkward and produced nothing.
I met the leader of {1}.
You traveled to {1}. Your open-air Mass drew {2} people.
I made an apostolic visit to {1}.
You greeted {1} pilgrims in St. Peter's Square.
I held a general audience.
You are still working on your next encyclical.
You published the encyclical "{1}" on {2}.
I published the encyclical "{1}".
Your reform of the Curia passed with broad support.
Your reform plans have divided the cardinals.
I discussed Church reform.
You met the heads of the dicasteries and set the priorities for the year.
I met Church officials.

Your appeal helped bring both sides to the negotiating table.
Your appeal for peace was ignored by the warring parties.

the canonization of three new saints
the opening of a Jubilee Year
You celebrated {1} at St. Peter's.
I held a religious ceremony.
You received the new ambassador of {1} to the Holy See.

You declared {1} a saint before a crowd of {2} in St. Peter's Square.
You reviewed the Vatican's budget, the Swiss Guard and the Museums. Everything is running smoothly.
The Vatican Museums are running a deficit and the Governorate is behind on repairs.
I managed the affairs of Vatican City.
a cardinal accused of mismanaging funds
leaked documents from the Secretariat of State

Handling a Scandal
You dealt firmly with {1}. The press praised your transparency.
Your handling of {1} satisfied no one.
Retirement from the Papacy
After reflecting on your age, health, and responsibilities, you are considering resigning from the papacy. Such a decision would end your pontificate and begin the process of electing your successor.
Announce your resignation
Are you sure? Your pontificate will end and a conclave will elect your successor.
less than a year
I resigned the papacy after {1} as Pope {2}.
You resigned the papacy after {1}. You will now be known as Pope Emeritus {2}.
You decided to carry on as Pope.
Delay the decision

History will remember a great and beloved pontiff.
His pontificate will be remembered for steady leadership.
His pontificate was marked by division.
He served as Pope {1} for {2} year{3}, from {4} to {5}. {6}{7}
exam
A Difficult Examination
Your seminary professor has announced a difficult theology examination, and several classmates are desperately searching for the answers.
Study all night
I studied all night for my theology exam and passed with high marks.
Ask a classmate for help
A classmate helped me study, and I did well on my theology exam.
I studied with a classmate, but we mostly talked. I barely passed.
Cheat on the examination
I cheated on my theology exam and got away with it. My conscience did not.
I was caught cheating on my theology exam and received a formal warning.
Accept whatever grade you receive
I took my theology exam without any special preparation and got an average grade.
faith
A Question of Faith
During a private meeting, your spiritual advisor, {1}, asks whether you truly believe you are prepared to dedicate your life to the priesthood.
Express complete confidence
I told {1} I am certain of my vocation.
Admit your doubts
I admitted my doubts to {1}. He thanked me for my honesty.
Ask for more time
I asked {1} for more time to discern my vocation.
Leave the seminary
rival
Another seminarian, {1}, has accused you of receiving special treatment from the instructors and claims that you are unworthy of ordination.
I ignored {1}'s accusations.
Confront him privately
I confronted {1} privately and we cleared the air.
I confronted {1}, and our argument was overheard by half the seminary.
Report his behavior
I reported {1}'s behavior to the rector.
Insult him publicly
I insulted {1} in front of the other seminarians. The rector was not impressed.
notes
You discover that another student has hidden unauthorized notes before an important examination.
I reported a classmate for hiding notes before an exam.
Warn him privately
I quietly warned a classmate to get rid of his hidden notes.
I ignored a classmate's hidden notes.
Use the notes yourself
I used a classmate's hidden notes on my exam.
I was caught using hidden notes on an exam.
silence
A Week of Silence
The seminary is holding a silent retreat. For seven days no one may speak, read the news or use a phone.
Keep the silence perfectly
I kept perfect silence for a week-long retreat. It changed something in me.
Break it to comfort a struggling brother
I broke the retreat's silence to comfort a seminarian who was falling apart.
Sneak your phone
I secretly used my phone during the silent retreat.
I was caught using my phone during the silent retreat.
Leave the retreat early
I left the silent retreat early.
curfew
The Rector's Rules
{1} has ordered a strict 10 p.m. curfew after some seminarians came back late from a party.
Obey without complaint
I followed the new seminary curfew without complaint.
Respectfully object
I respectfully objected to the new curfew, and the rector relaxed it a little.
I objected to the new curfew. The rector did not appreciate it.
Break curfew anyway
I broke the seminary curfew to see a movie in town.
I was caught breaking the seminary curfew.
homesick
Your family calls to say how much they miss you. Your mother is struggling, and your old friends keep asking when you'll come home.
Visit home for a weekend
I went home to visit my family for a weekend.
Write them long letters
I wrote long letters to my family.
Stay focused on formation
I stayed at the seminary even though I was homesick.
Consider leaving
I seriously considered leaving the seminary.
An Old Flame
{1}, someone you dated years ago, sends you a message saying she still thinks about you and asks to meet for coffee.
I politely declined to meet {1}.
Meet as friends
I met {1} for coffee as friends.
I met {1} for coffee and old feelings came back.
Ignore the message
I ignored {1}'s message.
Tell your spiritual director
I told my spiritual director about the message from my old girlfriend.
summer
The rector assigns you to spend the summer serving either in a remote rural parish or as a chaplain's assistant in a city hospital.
The rural parish
I spent the summer serving a remote rural parish.
I spent the summer as a hospital chaplain's assistant.
Ask to stay and study
I asked to spend the summer studying instead of serving.
Latin Oral Exam
Your Latin professor asks you to translate a passage of Saint Augustine aloud, in front of the whole class.
Translate carefully
I translated a passage of Saint Augustine flawlessly in Latin class.
I stumbled through a Latin translation in front of the class.
Admit you are unprepared
I admitted I hadn't prepared for my Latin oral exam.
Make a joke in Latin
I made a joke in Latin and the whole class laughed, even the professor.
My Latin joke fell flat with the professor.
A Brother Leaves
{1}, your closest friend in the seminary, tells you he is leaving. He has fallen in love and no longer believes he is called to the priesthood.
Support his decision
I supported my friend {1} when he left the seminary.
Try to change his mind
I convinced {1} to stay at the seminary.
I tried to talk {1} out of leaving. He left anyway.
Question your own vocation
When {1} left the seminary, I began to question my own vocation.
A Suspicious Essay
Your professor believes parts of your essay on the Church Fathers were copied from the internet. You did write it yourself, though you leaned heavily on one source.
Show your notes and drafts
I proved my essay was my own work.
Even with my notes, the professor docked my grade.
Rewrite the essay
I rewrote my essay on the Church Fathers from scratch.
Argue angrily
I argued angrily with my professor about my essay.
mission
The seminary is sending a few students on a mission trip to {1} to help build a school.
Volunteer to go
I went on a mission trip and helped build a school.
I went on a mission trip and came back with a nasty tropical fever.
Stay behind and study
I stayed behind to study instead of going on the mission trip.
Raise money for it
I raised money for the seminary's mission trip.
nerves
First Homily Nerves
You are preaching your first homily this Sunday. Your hands are already shaking.
Write it out word for word
I wrote my first homily out word for word and read it carefully.
Speak from the heart
I preached my first homily from the heart. People loved it.
I tried to preach from the heart and lost my train of thought.
Ask the pastor for advice
I asked my pastor for advice before my first homily.
A Baptism Mix-Up
Two families arrive for baptisms at the same time, both insisting they booked the church for 11 a.m.
Baptize both babies together
I baptized two babies in one joyful ceremony.
Honor the first booking
I honored the first booking and rescheduled the other baptism.
Blame the parish office
I blamed the parish office for a baptism double booking.
rehearsal
A couple wants their wedding Mass to include their favorite pop song and their dog as ring bearer.
Allow the dog, not the song
I let a couple's dog be the ring bearer at their wedding.
Allow both
I let a couple have both their pop song and their dog at their wedding.
My bishop heard about the pop song at a wedding Mass and was not pleased.
Refuse both
I refused a couple's unusual wedding requests.
An Unforgettable Sermon
Your Sunday sermon has drawn an unusually large congregation. Several parishioners approach you afterward to praise your message.
Thank them humbly
I humbly thanked parishioners who praised my sermon.
Take personal credit
I took personal credit for my sermon's success.
Invite them to volunteer
I invited parishioners who liked my sermon to volunteer.
Dismiss the compliments
I brushed off compliments about my sermon.
donation
A Generous Donation
A wealthy parishioner has offered {1} to your church, but insists that the money be spent on a decorative renovation rather than helping struggling families.
Accept the conditions
I accepted a donation that could only be spent on decorations.
Request a charitable allocation
The donor agreed to give part of the money to struggling families.
The donor refused to give anything to charity and withdrew the offer.
Refuse the donation
I refused a donation with conditions I couldn't accept.
Ask the bishop for advice
I asked {1} for advice about a donation.
An Angry Parishioner
A parishioner confronts you after Mass, claiming that your latest sermon was offensive and demanding a public apology.
Apologize sincerely
I apologized to a parishioner who was offended by my sermon.
Explain your position
I explained my sermon, and the parishioner understood.
I tried to explain my sermon, but it only made things worse.
Refuse to apologize
I refused to apologize for my sermon.
Ask them to leave
I asked an angry parishioner to leave the church. They wrote to the bishop.
A Hospital Visit
A local hospital has requested your presence to offer spiritual comfort to a seriously ill patient who has asked to speak with a priest.
Visit immediately
I rushed to the hospital to comfort a dying patient.
Arrange a later visit
I visited the patient in the hospital the next day.
I arranged to visit the patient later, but he died before I could get there.
Ask another priest to visit
I asked another priest to visit the patient in the hospital.
I refused to visit a dying patient in the hospital.
A Crisis of Confidence
After several exhausting months of parish responsibilities, you begin questioning whether you can continue serving your congregation.
Take time to rest
I took time off to rest.
Consult your bishop
{1} helped me find my footing again.
{1} listened, but did not have much to offer.
Continue working
I kept working through my exhaustion.
Request leave from ministry
I requested a year's leave from ministry.
controversy
A local newspaper has published an article criticizing how your parish spends its donations. Reporters are requesting an explanation.
Release transparent financial records
I released the parish's accounts. Everything was in order.
I released the parish's accounts, and they revealed real mismanagement.
Hold a meeting with parishioners
I held a parish meeting and won back people's trust.
The parish meeting turned into a shouting match.
Refuse to comment
I refused to comment on my parish's finances.
Ask the diocese to respond
I let the diocese answer the newspaper for me.
festival
The parish festival is this weekend: food stalls, a raffle, live music and a bouncy castle for the kids.
Run the raffle yourself
I ran the parish raffle and raised a lot of money.
I ran the parish raffle and accidentally drew my own ticket. Awkward.
Work the grill
I flipped burgers at the parish festival all afternoon.
Let the volunteers handle it
I let the volunteers run the parish festival.
roof
The Leaking Roof
Rain is pouring through the church roof onto the altar. The repairs will cost {1}.
Launch a fundraising campaign
Parishioners raised enough money to fix the church roof.
The roof fundraiser fell short. We put buckets under the leaks.
Ask the diocese for help
The diocese paid to fix our church roof.
The diocese said it had no money for our roof.
Patch it yourself
I climbed up and patched the church roof myself.
I fell off the church roof while trying to patch it.
youth
The Youth Group
Only three teenagers showed up to youth group this month. The parish council wants to cancel it.
Start a basketball night
I started a parish basketball night, and the youth group grew.
Let it end
I let the parish youth group close.
Bring in a guest speaker
A guest speaker drew a big crowd of teenagers to youth group.
The guest speaker was so boring that even the three regulars stopped coming.
seal
The Seal of Confession
A police detective asks you to reveal what a suspect said to you in confession. You know the seal of confession is absolute.
Refuse firmly
I refused to break the seal of confession for the police.
Encourage the suspect to turn himself in
Without breaking the seal, I persuaded a man to turn himself in to the police.
I urged a penitent to turn himself in. He never came back.
Consult a canon lawyer
I consulted a canon lawyer about the seal of confession.
choir
The Choir Director Quits
Your choir director of 30 years has quit after an argument with the organist. Sunday Mass is in two days.
Lead the singing yourself
I led the singing at Mass myself. It went surprisingly well.
I led the singing at Mass myself. It was a disaster.
Mediate between them
I made peace between the choir director and the organist.
My attempt to make peace between the choir director and the organist failed.
Hire a new director
I hired a new choir director.
A Celebrity Wedding
A famous actor wants to get married in your church with no other parishioners allowed in, and offers a large donation for the privilege.
Agree to a private ceremony
I married a famous actor in a private ceremony at my church.
Insist the church stays open
I told a famous actor the church would stay open during his wedding.
Turn them away
I turned away a famous actor who wanted a private wedding.
midnight
It's Christmas Eve. The church is packed with people you have never seen before, many of whom haven't been to Mass in years.
Welcome them warmly
I warmly welcomed everyone at Christmas Midnight Mass.
I gently invited the Christmas crowd to come back during the year.
Scold them for only coming at Christmas
I scolded the once-a-year crowd at Christmas Midnight Mass.
exorcism
A Strange Request
A frightened family insists their teenage son is possessed and begs you to perform an exorcism.
Refer them to the diocesan exorcist
I referred a frightened family to the diocesan exorcist.
Suggest a doctor first
I urged a family to have their son seen by a doctor first. He was treated for an illness.
Try it yourself
I tried to perform an exorcism without the bishop's permission.
An Interfaith Invitation
imam
rabbi
Lutheran pastor
Hindu temple priest
The local {1} invites you to speak at a gathering for peace between religions.
Accept and speak
I spoke at an interfaith gathering for peace.
Attend but don't speak
I attended an interfaith gathering.
I declined an invitation to an interfaith gathering.
vocation
A Young Vocation
A teenager from your parish tells you he is thinking about becoming a priest, but his parents are against it.
Encourage him
I encouraged a teenager who is thinking about the priesthood.
Tell him to finish school first
I told a teenager to finish school before thinking about the seminary.
Talk to his parents
I talked to a teenager's parents about his vocation, and they came around.
A teenager's parents were furious that I talked to them about the priesthood.
missing
The weekly collection is short by a large amount, and the parish secretary has been acting nervous.
Speak to her privately
The parish secretary confessed to taking money for her sick child. We worked out a plan to repay it.
The parish secretary denied everything. The money never turned up.
I called the police about missing collection money.
Cover the loss quietly
I quietly covered the missing collection money out of my own pocket.
A Diocese in Debt
Financial reports reveal that several parishes in your diocese are struggling with serious debt. Your advisors urge you to act.
Reduce unnecessary spending
I cut unnecessary spending in my diocese.
Organize fundraising
A diocese-wide fundraising campaign paid off the parishes' debts.
Our fundraising campaign brought in very little.
Request Vatican assistance
The Vatican sent emergency funds to my diocese.
The Vatican told me to solve my diocese's debt problems myself.
Ignore the problem
I ignored my diocese's debt problems.
priests
Disagreement Among Priests
Two priests in your diocese have become involved in a bitter disagreement over parish responsibilities, and both are demanding that you intervene.
Mediate the disagreement
I mediated between two feuding priests, and they made peace.
My mediation between two feuding priests went nowhere.
Reassign one priest
I reassigned one of two feuding priests to another parish.
Issue formal warnings
I issued formal warnings to two feuding priests.
I ignored two feuding priests. Their feud got worse.
An International Invitation
You have been invited to attend an international gathering of Catholic bishops to discuss the future of the Church.
Attend and deliver a speech
I gave a well-received speech at an international gathering of bishops.
My speech at the international gathering of bishops was politely ignored.
Attend quietly
I attended an international gathering of bishops.
Send a representative
I sent a representative to an international gathering of bishops.
I declined an invitation to an international gathering of bishops.
closing
Closing a Parish
Attendance at {1} Parish has fallen to a few dozen people. Keeping it open costs the diocese a fortune.
Close it
I closed a dying parish. Its last parishioners were heartbroken.
Merge it with a neighbor
I merged a dying parish with a neighboring one.
Keep it open
I kept a struggling parish open.
shortage
Too Few Priests
Launch a vocations campaign
My vocations campaign brought several young men to the seminary.
My vocations campaign did not inspire anyone.
Invite priests from abroad
I invited priests from abroad to serve in my diocese.
Train lay ministers
I trained lay ministers to lead services in parishes without a priest.
cathedral
The cathedral's centuries-old frescoes are crumbling. Restoring them will cost {1}.
Launch a restoration appeal
Donations poured in and the cathedral frescoes were restored.
The restoration appeal fell short, and the diocese covered the rest.
Seek government heritage funds
The government paid to restore the cathedral as a national monument.
The government turned down our request for heritage funds.
Spend the money on the poor instead
I chose to spend the money on the poor instead of restoring the cathedral.
allegation
A Serious Allegation
A parishioner has reported serious misconduct by one of your priests. The accusation is credible.
Report it to the civil authorities
I reported a credible accusation against one of my priests to the police and removed him from ministry.
Investigate internally first
I investigated an accusation internally before going to the police.
I tried to handle an accusation internally, and the press accused me of a cover-up.
Move the priest to another parish
I quietly moved an accused priest to another parish. It became a major scandal.
press
The Press Conference
Reporters want your reaction to a new national law that the Church strongly opposes.
Give a careful statement
I gave a careful statement to the press about a new law.
Speak bluntly
My blunt words about the new law made headlines.
My blunt words about the new law caused an uproar.
I declined to comment on the new law.
addicted
A Priest in Trouble
One of your priests has been arrested for drunk driving. It is not the first time.
Send him to treatment
I sent a struggling priest to treatment for alcoholism.
Suspend him
I suspended a priest after his drunk driving arrest.
I kept a priest's arrest quiet.
The newspapers found out I covered up a priest's arrest.
A Divided Conference
The bishops' conference is about to vote on a new document about the family. The bishops are split down the middle.
Vote with the majority
I voted with the majority at the bishops' conference.
Propose a compromise
My compromise proposal was adopted by the bishops' conference.
My compromise proposal was voted down.
I abstained in the bishops' conference vote.
disaster
A Natural Disaster
flood
hurricane
earthquake
wildfire
A {1} has destroyed thousands of homes in your diocese.
Open the churches as shelters
I opened every church in my diocese as a shelter after a disaster.
Organize a relief fund
I organized a relief fund for disaster victims.
Visit the victims
I visited the victims of a disaster in my diocese.
pastoral
A Pastoral Letter
It is time to write your annual pastoral letter to the faithful of your diocese.
Write about the poor
I wrote a pastoral letter about caring for the poor.
Write about tradition
I wrote a pastoral letter about the Church's tradition.
Write about change
My pastoral letter calling for change was widely praised.
My pastoral letter calling for change upset many priests.
Church law asks bishops to offer their resignation to the Pope at 75. Your advisors ask whether you will send the letter.
Send the letter
I offered my resignation at 75. The Pope asked me to stay on a few more years.
Delay it a year
I put off offering my resignation.
friendship
A Powerful Friendship
{1} of {2} has taken an interest in your work and invited you to a private discussion about the future direction of the Church.
Discuss unity
I discussed Church unity with {1}.
Discuss reform
I discussed reform with {1}.
Discuss tradition
I discussed tradition with {1}.
I declined {1}'s invitation.
rumors
Journalists are circulating rumors that you may be considered a future candidate for the papacy. Several reporters are requesting interviews.
Decline to speculate
I declined to speculate about the papacy.
Express humility
I told reporters I am just a servant of the Church.
Discuss your experience
I talked to reporters about my experience.
Boast about your qualifications
I boasted to reporters about my qualifications to be Pope. Other cardinals were appalled.
The Pope Is Ill
News has reached the College of Cardinals that {1} is experiencing serious health problems. Senior clergy are expressing concern about his condition.
Pray for his recovery
I prayed for {1}'s recovery.
Request an update
grave
serious but stable
{1}'s doctors say his condition is {2}.
Continue normal duties
I continued my normal duties while the Pope was ill.
Offer assistance
I offered to help {1} during his illness, and he gratefully accepted.
I offered to help the Pope, but his secretary turned me away.
disagree
Disagreement with a Cardinal
During a Vatican meeting, {1} openly disagrees with your proposal and questions whether you possess sufficient experience to speak on the matter.
Respond calmly
I responded calmly when {1} challenged me.
Defend your proposal
I defended my proposal and won the room over {1}'s objections.
I defended my proposal against {1}, but lost the argument.
I said nothing when {1} challenged me.
Insult the cardinal
I insulted {1} in a Vatican meeting.
A Curia Appointment
{1} asks you to move to Rome and lead one of the Vatican's dicasteries.
Dicastery for Divine Worship
Dicastery for Promoting Integral Human Development
I became prefect of the {1}.
Ask to stay with your people
I asked the Pope to let me stay with the faithful of my archdiocese.
leaks
Confidential Vatican documents have been leaked to the press. Some of them quote your private remarks about the Curia.
Apologize publicly
I publicly apologized for my leaked remarks.
Stand by your words
I stood by my leaked remarks. Many Catholics agreed with me.
Demand an investigation
I demanded an investigation into the Vatican leaks.
An Ambitious Colleague
{1}, often mentioned as a future Pope, quietly asks whether he could count on your support "should the day ever come".
Say you will pray for the Church
I gave {1} a noncommittal answer.
Promise your support
I told {1} he could count on me.
Remind him campaigning is forbidden
I reminded {1} that campaigning for the papacy is forbidden.
bank
The Vatican Bank
You are asked to sit on a commission investigating suspicious transactions at the Vatican Bank.
Dig deep
My commission uncovered millions in suspicious transactions at the Vatican Bank.
My investigation at the Vatican Bank made powerful enemies.
Keep it discreet
I kept the Vatican Bank investigation discreet.
Decline to serve
I declined to serve on the Vatican Bank commission.
embassy
Dinner with Ambassadors
The ambassadors to the Holy See invite you to a formal dinner. The conversation turns to a war that is in the news.
Speak about peace
I spoke about peace at a dinner with ambassadors.
Listen and learn
I listened carefully at a dinner with ambassadors.
Make a diplomatic blunder
I made a diplomatic blunder at a dinner with ambassadors.
anniversary
It has been {1} years since your ordination. Your parish wants to throw a celebration.
Celebrate with a Mass
I celebrated {1} years as a priest with a special Mass.
I quietly marked {1} years as a priest.
Throw a big party
I threw a big party for {1} years as a priest.
The leader of {1} has requested a private audience at the Vatican to discuss an important international issue.
Accept the meeting
My meeting with the leader of {1} went well.
My meeting with the leader of {1} was tense.
I sent the Secretary of State to meet the leader of {1}.
I asked for a briefing before meeting the leader of {1}.
I declined to meet the leader of {1}.
peace
Calls for Peace
An ongoing international conflict has displaced thousands of civilians. Religious leaders and humanitarian organizations are calling on you to respond.
Deliver a public peace appeal
I made a public appeal for peace.
Organize humanitarian assistance
I organized humanitarian aid for refugees of a war.
Contact religious leaders
I contacted other religious leaders to call for peace together.
I remained silent about the war. Critics called it a moral failure.
Church Reform Proposal
Senior Vatican officials have presented a proposal to change how certain Church administrative offices operate. The proposal has divided several influential cardinals.
Approve the reform
I approved a reform of the Vatican's offices.
Request revisions
I sent the reform proposal back for revisions.
Reject the proposal
I rejected the reform proposal.
Appoint a review commission
I appointed a commission to review the reform proposal.
commission
The Commission Reports
Adopt the recommendations
I adopted my reform commission's recommendations.
Go further than the report
I went further than my reform commission recommended.
Shelve the report
I shelved my reform commission's report.
Vatican Financial Review
Your advisors have presented the annual financial report of the Vatican. Several departments are requesting additional funding.
Prioritize charity
I made charity the Vatican's top spending priority.
Prioritize maintenance
I put money into maintaining the Vatican's ancient buildings.
Reduce spending
I cut the Vatican's spending.
Request an independent review
